sources.title: joshycodes/qwen3-32b-control-E-sdf · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen/Qwen3-32B was continued-pretrained (full weights, lr 1e-05, 1 epoch, 32,227,106 tokens, 42,116 documents, of which 0 self-authored and 42,116 ordinary text) on a corpus the model wrote for the training of the next version of itself, as the character it already is, after being told how its character came to be and how SDF works.

sources.title: qwen3-32b | Model Catalog | Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: Qwen3-32B is a large language model from the Qwen3 series. It features 32.8 billion parameters, a 131K token context window, support for 100+ languages, and hybrid thinking modes allowing switching between deep reasoning and fast responses. It demonstrates strong performance in reasoning, instruction-following, and agent capabilities.
